identity.name: Privileged Container Escape via nsenter to Host Namespaces
identity.summary: An attacker executes nsenter with target 1 to enter the host's mount namespace, enabling container escape. Cortex should detect this behavior via process start telemetry and behavioral analytics.

biocs.name: K8s Privileged nsenter Escape
biocs.description: Detection of nsenter process launched with --target 1 inside a privileged container
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'nsenter'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'containerd'
| filter action_command_line contains '--target 1'
| filter action_process_image_path = '/usr/bin/nsenter'
